name: MCN Media
shortDescription: A Northern Ireland service for livestreaming churches, cathedrals and funeral homes. It offers live viewing, recordings and optional password protection.
company: Service Stream Ltd (company number NI694018), trading as MCN Media
suitableContexts: Churches or cathedrals needing a managed live-service stream
Parishes that need public or password-protected viewing
Churches wanting a specialist provider across the UK and Ireland

gdprInformation: MCN publishes church livestreaming guidance that discusses attendee visibility, password protection and recording retention. This is supplier guidance, not a substitute for the church’s own data-protection assessment. Obtain the current agreement, controller/processor roles, hosting and sub-processor information, retention settings, deletion workflow and international-transfer details before recording services or handling personal data.
importExport: Supplier states that recordings can be deleted from its website or deletion can be requested by email
Confirm download, archive export, media ownership and deletion evidence before purchase
support: Published support email and Northern Ireland contact details
Confirm support hours, incident response, installation and live-event cover in the agreement

uk-operator.value: MCN’s terms identify Service Stream Ltd, trading as MCN Media, as the operator. Companies House lists Service Stream Ltd, number NI694018, as an active Northern Ireland company.

church-workflow.value: MCN’s service page lists churches and cathedrals across Northern Ireland, England and Scotland and describes church livestreaming, recordings, password protection and social-platform streaming.

privacy-guidance.value: Supplier guidance discusses camera positioning, notices, password-protected streams and recording retention for churches, weddings, funerals and services involving children.

support.value: The service home page advertises seven-day support and publishes contact routes from Cookstown, Northern Ireland.

editorial.assessment: MCN Media is a managed livestreaming provider rather than a general church database or sermon-management system. Its church and cathedral focus, optional password protection and published guidance make it relevant to UK parishes, especially where a managed setup is preferable to operating a self-service platform. The public material does not establish pricing, contract, hosting or data-processing detail, so those matters should determine whether it is suitable for a particular service.
bestFor: Churches and cathedrals seeking a specialist managed streaming service
Parishes that need optional restricted viewer access
Teams that want a supplier-led livestream setup and ongoing support
strengths: Church and cathedral workflow is explicit

limitations: No current public church price was located

Churches remain responsible for their own lawful notices, consent decisions and service-recording policy
Hosting, sub-processors, exact retention controls, export and contract terms require written supplier evidence

procurementVerdict.problem: Providing a reliable managed livestream for services while controlling who can view recordings
procurementVerdict.differentiator: A Northern Ireland-operated church and cathedral streaming specialist with optional password protection and published privacy-aware guidance
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Obtain a written proposal covering the exact camera setup, viewer access, storage, deletion, emergency support, licensing responsibilities and data-processing terms, then test a real service
